before; any other error names the repo-local path and marks it
"(unreadable)" so the operator's next step is a chmod, not an edit.

Same failure shape as C1 one layer down in this file: treating "could
not determine" as a specific answer instead of naming it as
indeterminate.

Regression test denies search permission on the repo-local archetypes
directory (skipped on Windows and as root, where the trick does not
reproduce EACCES) and confirms it fails against the pre-fix code.
EOF
)"
